items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: That was the day before Kennedy's Inauguration Ball.

ctx.x: So I told Basie that 'Sure, I'd like to stay with the band.' And he wanted to know whether I wanted to join the band, and I told him 'Sure.' And we talked money and the price was right for me at that time, the price was right. So I said, 'Sure.' So I stayed.
I stayed in that band. That was the day before Kennedy's Inauguration Ball.
